# Watermark

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Configures text drawn over or behind every page of a document.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Watermark(text?: string)
new Watermark(options: WatermarkOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`color`](#color): Color of the watermark text (default: gray-500).
- [`fontName`](#fontname): Font family name for the watermark text (default: "Helvetica").
- [`fontSize`](#fontsize): Font size in points for the watermark text (default: 72).
- [`opacity`](#opacity): Opacity of the watermark from 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (fully opaque).
- [`rotationDegrees`](#rotationdegrees): Rotation angle in degrees.
- [`text`](#text): The watermark text to display (e.g. "DRAFT", "CONFIDENTIAL").

### `color`

```typescript
color: Color
```

Color of the watermark text (default: gray-500). Accepts a palette token (`'slate-400'`) or hex (`'#ff00aa'`).

Example, from `code-recipes/security/watermarking-confidential`:

```typescript
watermark.color = Color.red;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/security/watermarking`:

```typescript
watermark.color = ColorPalette.slate[400];
```

### `fontName`

```typescript
fontName: string
```

Font family name for the watermark text (default: "Helvetica").

Example, from `code-recipes/security/watermarking`:

```typescript
watermark.fontName = StandardFonts.HelveticaBold;
```

### `fontSize`

```typescript
fontSize: number
```

Font size in points for the watermark text (default: 72).

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `code-recipes/security/watermarking-confidential`:

```typescript
watermark.fontSize = 60;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/security/watermarking`:

```typescript
watermark.fontSize = 120;
```

### `opacity`

```typescript
opacity: number
```

Opacity of the watermark from 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (fully opaque). Default: 0.15.

Example, from `code-recipes/security/watermarking`:

```typescript
watermark.opacity = 0.12;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/security/watermarking-confidential`:

```typescript
watermark.opacity = 0.08;
```

### `rotationDegrees`

```typescript
rotationDegrees: number
```

Rotation angle in degrees. Negative values rotate counter-clockwise. Default: -45 (diagonal from bottom-left to top-right).

Example, from `code-recipes/security/watermarking`:

```typescript
watermark.rotationDegrees = -45;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/security/watermarking-confidential`:

```typescript
watermark.rotationDegrees = -55;
```

### `text`

```typescript
text: string
```

The watermark text to display (e.g. "DRAFT", "CONFIDENTIAL").
